## InvalidMarketParameterError class

Thrown when a market parameter cannot satisfy Midnight protocol rules.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class InvalidMarketParameterError extends Error
```
**Extends:** Error

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.parameter`<!-- -->: Invalid market parameter name.

- `params.value`<!-- -->: Invalid market parameter value.

- `params.instruction`<!-- -->: Optional instruction appended to the error message.

- `params.cause`<!-- -->: Optional wrapped cause.

## Example


```ts
import { InvalidMarketParameterError } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

throw new InvalidMarketParameterError({
  parameter: "collateralParams",
  value: 0,
  instruction: "Provide at least one collateral.",
});
```
